findings.title: New TAKT_FAKE_REVIEW_CALLS error branches are never exercised
findings.detail: Review() now opens/writes/closes a calls-log file (lines 30-42) and returns an errorResult on any OpenFile, WriteString, or Close failure. No test in the wave (or elsewhere in the repo) drives any of these three failure modes — e.g. by pointing TAKT_FAKE_REVIEW_CALLS at an unwritable path or a directory. This is brand-new logic that other tests now depend on for correctness (oploop_test.go's TestSpecGateSpendsASecondScopedReviewOnABlockingRework and close_internal_test.go's TestBlindTaskReviewPromptNeverSeesTheLensClaims both rely on this file being written correctly to look up a call's exact LogID), so a silent regression in the write/error path (e.g. swallowing the error instead of returning it, or writing a malformed line) would go undetected.
